Reconsidering: The test image shows many small (1-2mm), dark, scattered discrete spots on the leaf — this pattern is classic for **Bacterial Speck of Tomato**, which produces very small dark brown to black specks, often with subtle yellow halos. TSWV does not match (no mosaic, no ring patterns). Septoria shows tan/gray centers which aren't visible here. Early Blight shows larger concentric-ring lesions.
